issues.statement: The Parents in these transform pairs (except train:0029) instead deposited the object into the appliance and cycled its door before the transformation succeeded
issues.reason: train:0022 is one of these transform pairs (the same item counts it among the pairs whose outcomes it summarizes), and its supplied Parent records contradict the near-universal claim: the Parent arrived at a closed fridge, opened it once (P3:5, revealing only egg 2 and lettuce 1, i.e. no bread inside), and the very next Parent action cooled the bread it was holding (P3:6, "cool bread 1 with fridge 1"), then moved that same bread from hand to countertop 1 (P3:8). The Parent neither deposited the object into the appliance nor cycled its door, so train:0029 is not the only exception and the generalization about Parent behavior in these pairs is wrong.
